title: The Choice of Fate
next_chapter_hook: At the moment the Resonance of Fate completed, Chen Ji perceived another path he had never imagined—the end of that path seemed to stand a figure he absolutely should not have seen at this moment.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's words still echoed in his ears, yet the Tianji Record mark on Chen Ji's brow burned like a branding iron. He saw—those cold eyes beyond the chessboard, piercing through the void to gaze upon him, carrying a condescending scrutiny, as if observing an ant who believed itself to be a chess player. There was no emotional fluctuation in that gaze, only cold, eternal observation.

Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill spread from his spine to every limb. He was no stranger to being watched—every time he used the Tianji Record to foresee the future, he could faintly sense some deeper existence observing everything. But never before had that gaze been so...direct. Those eyes were not the indifference of Heavenly Dao, but a conscious, purposeful stare.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul briefly solidified, his voice low and urgent) Chen Ji, what you saw... is not something you should直视 at this moment. Restrain your perception and return to the choice before you. The master of those eyes—you are not yet qualified to touch.

(Han Lie snorted coldly, arms crossed over his chest, his domineering aura distorting the surrounding air) Mo Xiansheng, why bother with such nonsense? The fusion of the Twin Fates cannot wait any longer—if he continues to hesitate, our Xuanwu Sect doesn't mind making the choice for him! Our "Heavenly Fire Furnace" happens to need a strand of fate power to ignite the furnace core!

(Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, the burning sensation in his brow mark gradually subsiding. He looked at Han Lie, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his mouth) Han Gongzi makes quite a display of power. Heavenly Fire Furnace? Sounds terrifying indeed—unfortunately, I remember when you used this move last time, you were fooled by my useless persona and couldn't even touch my hem? Memory really varies from person to person.

(Han Lie's face changed dramatically, a flash of killing intent flickering in his eyes, but he quickly suppressed it, revealing a cold, sinister smile) Chen Ji, you'd better pray your mouth can save you at the critical moment. Though...(he licked his lips) I've gotten used to being humiliated by a废物. Let's see if you can still laugh when you truly face the choice of fate!

(Mo Xiansheng raised his hand, a illusory glow condensing in his palm, transforming into three suspended runes) Enough. Chen Ji, there are only three paths for the Twin Fates' future. First, complete fusion—you will inherit the complete legacy of the Twin Fates, but the price is that your personality, memories, and will will merge into one with the other. Second, complete independence—you maintain your own independence, but the power of fate will never be complete, and you will be trapped forever in the half-ruined Tianji Record.

text.content: Chen Ji listened quietly, his mind racing rapidly. Complete fusion meant losing oneself—this was unacceptable under any circumstances; complete independence meant never touching the true power of the Tianji Record, making all previous scheming and endurance meaningless. His fingers tightened slightly as he waited for the revelation of the third option.

dialogue.content: (The light in Mo Xiansheng's palm changed, the third rune suddenly blooming with colorful, flowing light) Third—Resonance of Fate. You and the Twin Fates maintain your respective independent consciousnesss, yet establish a resonance channel at the deepest part of your souls. At critical moments, you can share power, share perception, even share part of the Tianji Record's abilities. But resonance is not fusion—you are still you, still possessing complete self.

text.content: Resonance... Chen Ji chewed on this word. Wasn't this the balance he had been seeking all along? No need to abandon the self, yet able to obtain sufficient strength to face the coming chaos. But there was never a free lunch in this world—he could sense that this option must hide unknown costs. Mo Xiansheng choosing to propose this scheme at this moment was绝非偶然.

choice.prompt: What exactly was the cost of the Resonance of Fate? Chen Ji needed to confirm this before making his final decision.

choices.text: Inquire About the Cost of Resonance
choices.description: Before making a decision, one must弄清楚 the true cost of the third path. Know yourself and your enemy, and you will win every battle.
choices.risk_hint: May Provoke Mo Xiansheng or the Demonic Path Commander
choices.process_label: 陈机决定先问清楚代价再做决定

text.content: Chen Ji did not respond immediately, but stared directly into Mo Xiansheng's illusory eyes, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable resolve: "The Resonance of Fate sounds beautiful, but this Chen Ji never believes in free lunches. Speak—What is the cost of this scheme? Do I need to give something, or make some promise?"

choices.description: No need to hesitate too long—the balance between independence and power, this is the path most suitable for him.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Ability of Resonance of Fate
choices.process_label: 陈机果断选择命运共鸣

text.content: Chen Ji did not inquire about the cost, but instead stepped forward directly, his qi aura suddenly changing: "No need for more words. The third path—Resonance of Fate." His voice was not loud, yet carried unshakeable determination. The moment the words fell, the airflow in the entire great hall seemed to freeze for an instant.

choices.text: Demand to see the Demonic Path commander first
choices.description: The third option involves "Fate Twins"—the other party involved must be present before he can make a judgment.
choices.process_label: 陈机要求见证人必须到场

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze sweeping across Mo Xiansheng and Han Lie: "Fate resonance requires two people to complete. Since it involves the Fate Twins, where is the other party involved? Young Master Han represents the Xuanwu Sect's stance, but shouldn't someone from the Demonic Path commander's side be present to witness this moment as well?"

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly, seemingly expressing approval of Chen Ji's caution) You ask well. The price of fate resonance is precisely this—when the resonance channel is established, every time you share power, a mark will be left deep within your souls. The deeper the resonance, the heavier the mark. Eventually, when these marks accumulate to a certain degree...you will have to face a question: continue resonating, or completely fuse.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's words caused Chen Ji to fall into brief silence. This meant fate resonance was not a perfect solution, but merely a delaying tactic—it gave him and the Fate Twins more time, yet buried another time bomb deep within their souls. But compared to immediately losing himself, this price was already the limit he could accept. He raised his head, gazing toward the shadows deep within the main hall.

At this moment, from the shadows deep within the main hall, a graceful figure slowly emerged. Demonic Path mist swirled around her, outlining an icy and exquisite silhouette—precisely Ye Qing, the Demonic Path Saint. Her appearance caused Han Lie to instantly grow vigilant, his qi energy tensing sharply. "Interesting..." Ye Qing's voice was cold as an ice spring, "Fate resonance? That's rather more clever than I anticipated."

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing stepped forward slowly, the Demonic Path mist trailing long patterns behind her as she stared directly into Chen Ji's eyes) I speak on behalf of the Demonic Holy Sect—fate resonance, we accept. But as exchange, the power of the Demonic Path will merge into your Tianji Record system. From now on, every time you have a premonition, it will carry a thread of our Demonic Path's karma. Simply put...your Tianji Record will no longer be pure.

text.content: Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. The Tianji Record was his greatest trump card, the core of all his schemes. If the Tianji Record was no longer pure, it meant that when he used his foresight ability, he would inevitably be stained by the Demonic Path's karma—this was a fatal blow to someone who walked the world under the "waste" persona while secretly making arrangements. On the surface, Ye Qing's condition appeared to be cooperation, but in reality, she was making a cut at his most important ability.

dialogue.content: (Han Lie burst into laughter, the sound filled with schadenfreude) Ha! I knew it, there's no free lunch in this world! Chen Ji, your calculations are quite clever, but the people of the Demonic Path are no soft touches. The Tianji Record stained with Demonic Path karma? Tsk tsk, from now on every time you use your foresight ability, you're digging your own grave!

text.content: Chen Ji ignored Han Lie's mockery, staring fixedly at Ye Qing. He suddenly realized a problem—why would Ye Qing, as the Demonic Path Saint, accept fate resonance so readily? What was her true purpose? More importantly, how did she know about the fate resonance option? Mo Xiansheng had only just proposed this plan moments ago, yet she acted as if she had known about it all along...there must be some key point here that he hadn't yet seen through.

choice.prompt: What is the Demonic Path Saint's true intention? Chen Ji needs to弄清楚这一点 before reaching an agreement.

choices.description: The Demonic Path people will not help you for no reason, you must understand her true purpose in doing this.
choices.process_label: 陈机决定当面质问魔道圣女

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward, closing the distance with Ye Qing until they could almost sense each other's qi fluctuations: "The Saint's calculations are quite exquisite. The Tianji Record stained with Demonic Path karma sounds like helping me, but in reality it's making a cut at my ability, isn't it?" A cold smile curved at the corner of his mouth, "But I'm very curious—what is your true purpose in doing this?"

choices.text: Turn the tide and accept the conditions
choices.description: The Demonic Path wants to make a cut at his ability, but how could he not turn this around and make use of it? The enemy's schemes can also become one's own pieces.
choices.visible_cost: The Tianji Record is no longer pure
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the reverse blessing of Demonic Path power
choices.process_label: 陈机决定接受魔道条件

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, and that smile carried a depth that even made Ye Qing furrow her brow slightly: "What a wonderful Destiny Resonance." He said softly, "The Tianji Record stained with Demonic Path karma? It does sound terrifying—but what if I said this is precisely what I need?" His words left everyone present stunned.

choices.description: Since the Demonic Path wants his Tianji Record stained with karma, he could in turn demand something as compensation. A deal must be mutual.

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze calmly sweeping over Ye Qing and Han Lie: "Destiny Resonance is acceptable, but I have one condition." His voice was unhurried, "If the Demonic Path's power merges into the Tianji Record, then the karma of the Tianji Record must equally merge into the Demonic Path. From now on, I and the Demonic Path share prosperity and ruin together. Do you dare accept, Saint Lady?"

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing's eyes narrowed slightly; she clearly hadn't anticipated Chen Ji's reaction. Her fingers tapped lightly on the folded fan, and after a moment, a meaningful curve formed at the corner of her lips) Interesting... You think this can threaten me? But you're right—the deal should be mutual." She paused, "Since that's the case, I can add another筹码——the usage rights of the 'Demonic Mist.' When you need to conceal the Tianji Record's aura, you may use my ability.

text.content: Usage rights of the Demonic Mist? Chen Ji's heart stirred. This ability was like a timely gift—the Tianji Record consumed Heavenly Fate each time it was used, and that unique aura fluctuation was easily detectable. With the Demonic Mist's concealment, his foresight ability would become more covert, harder to trace. But he still suppressed the excitement in his heart, his expression unchanged as he looked at Ye Qing.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a soft sigh, a hint of relief in his tone) Well done. Since both parties have reached a preliminary consensus, now comes the moment to witness the Destiny Resonance. Chen Ji, walk to the center of the altar. When the Destiny Resonance is established, your soul will intertwine with that of the Destiny Twins—there, you will perceive the existence of another path. That path, perhaps, is the true ultimate.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and walked toward the altar at the center of the hall. It was a circular platform constructed of ancient runes, the glyphs emitting a ghostly blue glow in the darkness, as if a slumbering beast was slowly breathing. The moment he stepped onto the altar, the Tianji Record seal burned hot again—this time, not from external observation, but a summons from the depths of his soul.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing also stepped onto the opposite end of the altar, the Demonic Mist churning around her, intertwining with the blue light on the altar) Are you ready, waste?" Her voice was cold as frost, but a trace of barely perceptible anticipation flickered in her eyes, "From this moment, our fates will be entangled. Whether we head toward destruction or ascend to the peak together... depends on each person's fortune.

choice.prompt: Destiny Resonance is about to be established—should Chen Ji speak his final condition at this critical moment?

choices.description: There's no need to say more. Destiny Resonance is already set in stone; saying too much would only appear心虚.
choices.risk_hint: Missed the chance to争取 last leverage
choices.process_label: 陈机选择沉默，开始共鸣仪式

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing more, merely gazing quietly into Ye Qing's eyes. After a moment, he gave a slight nod, forming seals with both hands, and the power of the Tianji Record surged from his brow center. At the same time, Ye Qing made the same gesture—two entirely different powers converged at the altar's center, instantly blooming with dazzling light.

choices.text: Mock Han Lie one final time
choices.description: Before the Destiny Resonance begins, if he could stimulate this old rival further, wouldn't that be even more satisfying? After all, this Chen Ji never missed an opportunity to slap someone's face.
choices.process_label: 陈机决定在最后时刻嘲讽韩烈

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly tilted his head, looking at Han Lie standing at the altar's edge, a mocking arc curving at the corner of his lips: "By the way, Young Master Han, after I'm fate-bound to the Demonic Path Saint Lady, your Heavenly Fire Furnace threat seems even more meaningless, doesn't it? The waste and the Demonic Path妖女 joining forces—do you think your Dominance is stronger, or our schemes more lethal?"

choices.text: Asking Mo Xiansheng about that path
choices.description: Mo Xiansheng just mentioned "another ultimate path" — this was crucial information he must clarify.
choices.risk_hint: May miss the optimal moment for resonance
choices.process_label: 陈机在共鸣前追问那条道路

text.content: Just as the resonance was about to begin, Chen Ji suddenly spoke: "Wait." He looked at Mo Xiansheng, "You said I would perceive another path — where does that road lead? Is it a place higher than the Heavenly Dao, or... an entirely different direction?" This question concerned his future plans, and he had to understand it now.

In the instant when the radiance blazed brilliantly, Chen Ji felt his consciousness swept into a strange space by an immense force. There was no distinction between up and down, no passage of time, only endless strands of cause and effect intertwining and coiling through the Void. He saw his own thread of destiny, and also Ye Qing's thread of destiny — the two lines were slowly drawing closer, about to interweave.

Just as the two threads of destiny were about to touch, Chen Ji saw — deep within the dense web of cause and effect, there lay a path he had never seen before. That path was not on the Heavenly Dao's chessboard, not within the demonic path's great enterprise, not even within any of his countless schemes and calculations. It was a brand-new, completely independent road.

What shocked him even more was that at the end of that path, a blurred figure stood faintly visible. The outline of that figure... Chen Ji's heart lurched — it was clearly a woman's form. She had her back to him, her long hair floating in the Void, as if waiting for something. When Chen Ji tried to see her face clearly, a cold voice rang out in his mind — it was the voice of the Heavenly Eye.

dialogue.content: (The voice was cold and indifferent, as if the Heavenly Dao itself were speaking) Chen Ji, you have finally begun to touch the true boundary. But I warn you — that path is not a domain you should involve yourself in. Your sister Chen Nian still waits for me, and she... should not be found by anyone at this time. Especially not by you.

text.content: Chen Ji shuddered throughout his body. Chen Nian — his sister who had been missing for years, the one taken by the Holy Sect to serve as the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key." The Heavenly Eye actually took the initiative to mention her! What did this mean? A threat, or a warning? Or... at the end of that path, was that blurred figure his sister Chen Nian? Countless thoughts churned in his mind, but the process of destiny resonance did not stop — the two threads of destiny finally touched.

In that instant, an unprecedented power erupted from the intersection point of the two threads of destiny. That power belonged neither to the Tianji Record nor to the demonic path, but was a brand-new existence born from the perfect fusion of two forces. It flowed through all of Chen Ji's meridians, ultimately gathering at his Brow Center — the mark of the Tianji Record underwent a transformation at that moment, the originally incomplete runes becoming one degree more complete.

When the radiance faded, Chen Ji opened his eyes again. He found himself still standing on the altar, with Ye Qing standing not far across from him. Between the two of them, there seemed to be an invisible bond connecting their souls — the materialization of destiny resonance. Han Lie stood at the edge of the altar, his face ashen, clearly deeply dissatisfied with this scene. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul hovered in mid-air, a flicker of relief in his eyes.

Chen Ji lowered his head to look at his own hands — he could clearly perceive that a faint connection had been established between himself and Ye Qing. Her emotions, her partial thoughts, even the fluctuations of magical power within her — he could sense them all faintly. Was this the effect of destiny resonance? And based on this resonance, he discovered that his ability to foresee the future had indeed increased — the Tianji Record had become more complete.

But what concerned him even more was the existence of that path. The blurred figure standing at the path's end, the warning from the Heavenly Eye... Where exactly was Chen Nian? Why was the Heavenly Eye trying to prevent him from finding her? These questions circled in his mind, becoming a new mystery in his heart. He raised his head, looking toward some invisible direction in the Void — he perceived that there, something was waiting for him.
